bio.text: Maxine Waters represents California's 43rd Congressional District in the U.S. House; she was first elected in 1990 after 14 years in the California State Assembly.
She was the first woman and first African American to chair the House Financial Services Committee.
She was born in St. Louis, Missouri, in 1938, earned a bachelor's degree in sociology from California State University in 1970, and worked as a teacher for the Head Start program.
She is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
